description: Which figures a report cites were REVISED by a later filing? Resolves the report's cited facts to their filing, then matches each against the Restatement Radar feed (same raw XBRL tag, same reporting window, a different restating filing filed after the report was signed; an unsigned report is compared from the time it was last saved). Returns only the revised figures: `fact_id`, `cited_value` (as the report's filing states it), `current_value` (the latest filed number), `current_accession` (the filing that carries it), `revised_at` (when that filing was filed), plus `checked` (cited facts that could be judged) and `degraded`. READ `degraded`: true means the check could not be completed (a fact or company could not be read, or the report cites more than 3 companies), and an empty `revised` list then means NOTHING. Only `degraded: false` with an empty list means no cited figure was revised. WORDING: say 'revised', never 'restated'; this check cannot know why a number changed. `include_cause: true` adds `cause` (error | merger | reclass | none) and `cause_quote` read from the restating filing, with `cause_state`. Nothing is stored. Visibility is the same as get_report (your own reports, or published reports at their required tier).

include_cause.description: Also read WHY each figure was revised from the restating filing (adds one filing read per revised figure). Default false.

data_quality.description: Server-side invariants run on this response

fundamentals_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the FINANCIAL STATEMENTS were last rebuilt in bulk. Use THIS — not `last_updated` — when telling a user how current the cross-sectional fundamentals are. The snapshot is republished on every weekday price refresh while the statements are carried forward unchanged, so `last_updated` can be far more recent than the numbers it sits next to. It is a floor for a single filer, not a ceiling: a filer with a live partition receives its filing, facts and ratios intraday (minutes after EDGAR dissemination), so an entity-scoped read may carry a filing newer than this; cross-sectional ranks (factor scores, earnings signals) refresh with the weekly bulk export.

last_updated.description: ISO timestamp when the snapshot was exported

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds this tool call took, measured server-side around the handler.

limit_warnings.description: Soft-warning array for partial fulfillment. Each entry carries a stable subcode + remediation.options[]. AI agents pattern-match on subcode.

payg_override.description: Set when this single response was paid for via the agent-pay PAYG flow — the rate-limit / depth-limit checks were bypassed for this call only.

pit_safe.description: true iff a zero-look-ahead point-in-time cut was applied to every returned figure

price_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the price surfaces were last refreshed.

truncation.description: Set when fewer rows were returned than requested — explains why and points to a remedy

checked.description: Cited facts that were resolved and judged.

cited_value.description: The value the cited filing states.

current_accession.description: The later filing that carries current_value.

current_value.description: The latest filed value of the same tag and window.
